title: Feature Build & Scaling
subtitle: Working MVP, Manual Verification & Incremental Growth
summary: Choose the scope and commit existing code before development. Let AI test, try it yourself, and send errors back for repair. Then extend it and address growing demand.
keyTakeaway: Verify the core journey with automated checks and manual use, preserve a baseline, then extend behavior and capacity using measured evidence.

resources.title: Build a Verifiable MVP
resources.description: Turn confirmed requirements, contracts, and prototype states into small implementation steps with explicit verification evidence.
resources.content:
Read @requirements @technical-plan-and-interfaces @UI-prototype @current-code.

Build: paste material → generate three questions → answer → review explanations
and source. Do not add login, community, payments, or cross-device sync.
Keep questions and answers in the current page.

Propose development steps and questions first. Start after plan confirmation.
Implement in the order above, running checks after each step.
Follow the prototype and identify missing states.
Check Context7 or official docs for the installed versions; do not guess APIs.
Write tests before critical behavior. Start the app and try the journey yourself.
Explicitly report missing credentials and checks you cannot run.

Deliver startup and configuration instructions, actual test results,
and unfinished work.
resources.curatorNote: Use the chapter acceptance conditions and report actual checks separately from assumptions.

resources.title: Investigate a Manual Test Failure
resources.description: Report reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, and errors; require investigation, regression checks, and a manual retest.
resources.content:
I found this issue while trying the app. Please fix it.

Steps: [input and actions]
Expected: [what should happen]
Actual: [visible behavior or error text; screenshot optional]

Inspect code and logs. Ask for specific missing evidence rather than guessing
and making broad changes. Run checks after repair, confirm existing features
still work, and tell me how to repeat the steps to verify the fix.
resources.curatorNote: Use the chapter acceptance conditions and report actual checks separately from assumptions.

resources.title: Extend a Stable Practice Session
resources.description: Add one related practice question while preserving the original questions, answers, and source-review state.
resources.content:
The existing three-question practice works. Read the current docs and code.

Add: after a wrong answer, the user can click “Try another question.”
Generate one related question from the same material without replacing
existing questions or answers. Explain insufficient material; do not invent it.

Identify affected screens and interfaces and code that can be reused.
After plan confirmation, implement incrementally without unrelated rewrites.
Test the new question, then rerun the original session and failure retry.
resources.curatorNote: Use the chapter acceptance conditions and report actual checks separately from assumptions.

resources.title: Investigate a Scaling Bottleneck
resources.description: Establish a reproducible load baseline, locate the delay, and compare a minimal improvement under equivalent conditions.
resources.content:
Problem: [for example, generation often fails with two simultaneous users].
Environment, reproduction steps, and logs: [attach].

Find where it slows or fails and explain the evidence before adding a queue
or cache. Propose the smallest fix and its trade-offs.
State the request scale and budget before paid real-service tests.
Compare the same inputs and user count before and after the change,
and check question quality too.

resources.title: Incremental Feature Expansion & Benchmarking Prompt
resources.description: Safely integrates LLM video summarization and chaptering without regressing core download reliability.
resources.content:
You are expanding Universal Video Downloader.
Core download is stable. Before proposing edits, inspect current documentation and codebase.

## Goal
Add AI video summarization for rapid learning and content review.

## Context Sources
- @project-docs
- @current-codebase

## Tasks
Competitive analysis → Architecture RFC → Implementation

## Guardrails
1) Use Context7 and live search for up-to-date documentation; avoid deprecated APIs.
2) Prioritize additive, non-breaking modifications to the existing download pipeline.
3) Self-test end-to-end user journeys before requesting human review.
resources.curatorNote: Use cost-effective models during prototype validation, and keep API keys strictly in environment variables.
